Hi Emilia — thanks for the note and glad the runtime is productive. We can support an extension; two practical options below so procurement can pick the fastest path: 

Option A — Time-box extension (recommended)
- 2-week extension at the same capacity, no per-token surcharge.
- We include 40 engineering hours of integration support on us (remote).
- Any additional eng hours billed at a discounted rate of $220/hr (list $275/hr).
- Draft amendment attached: Lumina_POC_Amendment_draft.pdf (attaching SOW estimate).

Option B — Credit equivalent
- Convert a token credit equal to the estimated two-week usage (we can size this after a quick telemetry check).
- No bundled eng hours included; eng hours available at $240/hr.

Operational notes:
- We’ll route the amendment to legal for a 1-signature DocuSign.
- If procurement needs a PO-first flow we can accept a PO and invoice the added engineering hours monthly.

If you prefer a blended approach (more eng hours + smaller credit), say the number and we’ll try to meet you. I’m looping Kar on the pricing and Marissa for billing.
